currentness.active_work: Other Turnstone worktrees and existing Mere untracked node_modules preserved.

product_contract: Current-session live graph member capture-reference facets are the only source admissions; no evidence-store inventory, recovery receipt, visited-only PageText or other-session corpus fallback.

Search is exact-case substring matching over validated canonical text, with metadata fallback and list mode. One hit per exact session/graph/member/annotation identity; occurrence order remains in admissions. Equal-text provenance stays distinct.
A result carries immutable annotation identity, canonical-text BLAKE3 and optional half-open Unicode scalar selector. Its internal address persists view intent, not a text copy or origin request.

The existing session trail actor resolves exact IDs using public Fleece NoFetcher validation and stronger R0 raw/annotation/privacy/provenance checks. No second Fjall owner, ClipRecord import, supplier fork or new shared reader abstraction.

A host-resolved EngineDocument is rendered through the existing retained SmolwebDocumentSession. It reveals the selected quote and full canonical text, origin, capture time and compact saved version. Open original address is a separate explicit link.

Actor generation, request, owning session/store, live source facet and current reader view URL are rechecked. Late/retargeted replies cannot install text; adoption, explicit open, retarget, history navigation and reload discard transient read state.
Missing/corrupt records remain identifiable unavailable entries. Invalid hash/range/owner/ref cannot fetch or substitute another version. No joined place or inference resident is required.
R0/R1 save acknowledgement and retention remain unchanged. The current node title is a view label, not a promised immutable historical capture title.
integration_repairs: The command is registered in the static palette catalog rather than appended outside its sources.
Reader open resolves the focused pane graph rather than the legacy runtime cursor, and refuses a foreign-session reader view.
Retarget/reload/history navigation withdraw pending read dedup state so returning can resolve again.
Existing identity-watch test now separately awaits root delivery and the host wake callback; it no longer assumes callback scheduling after receive. Production identity code is unchanged.

portable_cargo_mode.cargo: Homebrew 1.99.0 wrapper default; explicit build/tests/Clippy use rustup 1.99.1

headed_native.note: Runner stops the actual loopback origin, waits for process exit and ECONNREFUSED, acknowledges a fresh control file, and keeps the origin dead through offline search/read and a fresh process. No manual focus intervention.

startup_fixture.kind: historical immutable no-wallet identity/cookie custodian only
startup_fixture.note: Production source reads use the current App/trail/Fjall path. No current Djinn release qualification inferred.

qualification_limits: 10 ignored tests and the 89 shared-place/Sky tests excluded from the bounded suite are not counted as passes. Three capture-library controls are reported separately.
App-native headed keyboard, pointer/catalog and presentation on macOS. No OS assistive activation, physical-device recovery, Windows or Linux qualification.
Ordinary saved HTML canonical text is readable offline; no hosted page replay, screenshot/PDF capture, preserved HTML formatting, R3 Answers or R4 full research workflow claim.
Persistence retains R0 acknowledged writes and tested process-exit/reopen survival. No cross-store atomic transaction or power-loss guarantee is added.
Retarget/history/stale-response refusal and corrupt/missing records are tested in App/actor/storage controls; the headed packet does not click the separate original-address link.
